# Final Implementation Plan

The Awtsmoos now binds Chessed of possibility to Gevurah of exact files and tests;
Awtsmoos.com will change only after each dependency has shown the shape in which it rests.

## Before source mutation

1. Fetch `origin/main` and verify current root/relevant-file concurrency.
2. Read the exact current Chitas files in full.
3. Locate and read the normal post-reader route/loader in full using narrow file discovery.
4. Read the internal Tanach source adapter/payload in full.
5. Freeze exact touched-file list.

## Generic reference system files

Create small modules under `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/dynamic-reference/`:

- `reference-contract.js`: validate typed ordered references; no UI or network.
- `reference-id.js`: stable URL-safe dynamic post identity helpers.
- `reference-registry.js`: adapter registration and dispatch.
- `post-composer.js`: resolve ordered references into one normal post-reader model.

If the existing reader already exposes equivalent composition primitives, reduce this set rather than duplicate them.

## Chitas files

- `chitas/range-reference.js`: translate schedule aliyah boundaries to the chosen internal Tanach/post range model.
- `chitas/week-state.js`: parse/serialize date, language, Israel/Diaspora and week navigation.
- `chitas/dynamic-post.js`: reconstruct `chitas-YYYY-MM-DD` from URL state and resolve selected Torah range.
- `chitas/week-controls.js`: pure UI model for selector labels and actions.
- Rewrite `schedule.js` only if needed to output structured boundaries in addition to display labels.
- Rewrite `virtual-series.js` so cards are ordinary internal posts with no `externalHref` and no social suppression marker.

## Existing reader/navigation integration

- Fully rewrite the located post loader/router so `seriesId === daily-chitas` + `postId === chitas-YYYY-MM-DD` resolves through `chitas/dynamic-post.js`; ordinary persisted posts retain existing path.
- Keep the existing native post/Tanach reader and comments/social components.
- Add a small Chitas masthead module/style rather than fork the reader.
- Rewrite `living-path/cards.js` to remove Chabad allowlist/external navigation and make Chitas cards follow the ordinary internal post route.

## Week and language UX

- Segmented Hebrew / English selector.
- Previous week, Today, Next week buttons.
- Date input allowing any selected week/day.
- English + Hebrew parsha title.
- Sunday→Shabbos cards with selected/today states.
- URL query is the source of truth and supports hard reload/back/forward.
- Minimum 48px mobile actions where practical.

## Reader UX

- Chitas masthead: weekday, aliyah, selected date, parsha, canonical range.
- Native Torah typography/body.
- RTL Hebrew and LTR English scoped to text.
- Normal comments/social/share controls.
- Verse comments retain canonical `verseSection`.
- No external Torah-study navigation.

## Tests to write/update

1. Dynamic reference contract parse/validate/serialize tests.
2. Range parser tests for same-chapter and cross-chapter aliyos.
3. Stable dynamic post ID and reload reconstruction tests.
4. Week-state tests: any date, previous/next/today, Hebrew/English, Israel/Diaspora.
5. Existing Chitas schedule tests including festival deferral, Simchas Torah, Isru Chag.
6. Living Path contract: Chitas cards have internal IDs and no externalHref/Chabad host.
7. Normal post-card regression: ordinary internal navigation/social remains intact.
8. Reader integration: direct daily-chitas URL resolves internal Torah text.
9. Comment integration: comments UI exists; verseSection source identity is stable.
10. Browser 320/375/390/430: no horizontal overflow, no dock overlap, selectors usable, language/date/week state correct, hostname remains Awtsmoos.com.
11. Browser hard reload of a selected Hebrew week/post.
12. Search changed subtree for `chabad.org`, `externalHref`, `virtualStudy`.

## Verification / deployment

- Read back every touched file completely.
- Compare this plan against actual implementation and write a new non-overwriting delta file.
- If anything is missing, perform a second complete-file write pass.
- Re-read all touched files again and write final plan-vs-actual audit.
- Run node syntax/tests, line ceiling, tab indentation checks, prologues, `git diff --check`.
- Fetch newest origin, integrate concurrent canonical work, rerun affected gates.
- Commit and push exact SHA without force.
- Activate through the repository production release path.
- Verify public bytes and real Ikar mobile flow from grouping → selected week → Chitas post → Torah text/comments.

## Completion invariant

The task is not complete merely when a card opens. Completion means the current screenshot failure is impossible: clicking Chitas remains on Awtsmoos, resolves our Torah source, preserves normal comments/social, supports arbitrary week and Hebrew/English state, formats correctly on mobile, survives hard reload, and is live in production.
